features: BORSSO ULTIMA’s 2026 Edition is a new launch of “ULTIMA GEN-5” a new premium flagship range of our most popular model ULTIMA from BORSSO is inspired by new era technical needs of customer. ULTIMA is result of R&D of last 4 years with observation of our customer needs and suggestions.

[ULTIMA GEN - 5] offers top of the line performance BORSSO ULTIMA GEN - 5 addition is a bunch of features of Projector with 4K Ultra HD 60 FPS and Real HDR10+ / HLG support in HDMI Port. Native 1080p Resolution with True HDR 10+ & 4K 60 FPS Support enhance complete home cinema experience. A Ultra Bright 3850 ANSI Peak Lamp Brightness offers Deep 60000:1 High Dynamic Contrast make it suitable for various environment ULTIMA GEN -5 A Semi Closed Engine, by AI Super Color chipset enhanced contrast, deep color and clarity to perfection. The advance Vivid Cinema Engine image processing creates ultra-realistic images by presenting more vivid colors. 50000 Hours of Lamp Life.

[FPGE Keystone & 4K Upgraded Lens] First time in Indian, the FPGE Keystone with pixel shifting technology help to maintain image resolution even upto 20% keystone use. Also equipped with an AI based Full auto Projection camera that effectively improves focusing, Auto (Focus+Keystone+Obstacle Avoidance+Tilt), 4K Upgraded Lens (5 Element LaF High Defination Lens) comes with impressive short throw ratio of 1:25:1 which allow you to build 100 inch display just from 10 to 11 feet distance max 300 inch display focus capacity.

[Cross Matrix LED + LTPO] is 1st Indian projector Introducing LTPO New Generation Highly Transparent Display offers high brightness with Cross Matrix LED for low power consumption 3850 ANSI Peak Lamp Brightness with three adjustable Brightness levels—High (3850 ANSI), Standard (3200 ANSI), and Low Noise(2800 ANSI). The HDR10 decoding technology with control switch to on and HDR and MEMC effects, coupled with BrightVis technology, lets you enjoy any video content in amazing vibrant colorful HDR graphics. Latest 6th Gen Wifi Support (2.4G Wifi Support: Adopts the latest 5G wifi chip), enjoy the fast and fluent internet get the best movie enjoyment! Bluetooth 5.2.

[10W×3 Stereo DSP Speakers] is equipped Powerful Sound: 10W×3 stereo DSP speakers with 3D surround sound (Bass Diaphragm) for an immersive audio experience HDMI ARC and SPDIF support fast and stable connections with external speakers for a more immersive audio experience. Wireless Screen Mirroring: Supports AirPin, Miracast, compatible with both Android and iOS devices.

[MEMC & Game Mode] which stands for Motion Estimation, Motion Compensation, is a technology used in many TVs and projectors to improve the smoothness of on-screen motion, especially in fast-action scenes. It works by analyzing the movement between frames and generating new, intermediate frames to be inserted, effectively increasing the frame rate and reducing motion blur and judder. Game Mode: dedicated for ultra smooth gaming experience by reducing input lag for instant button –to-Screen Action,

Warranty Information - BORSSO Indian Brand with 1 year (12 months) Comprehensive off site warranty on Projector and 2 Years on Lamp provided by BORSSO from date of purchase | It is mandatory to register warranty of your product to avail warranty benefits within 10 days from the date of delivery. For more details please brand website.
